name: Optometrist

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Eye exam with a contact lens fitting
services.story: The main story: an eye exam with a contact lens fitting, $165 on the list. Nothing is taken. The desk checks Alex's vision plan, and Alex pays the share at the front desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Marcus (eye doctor) and Leo (optician), who travel with a portable eye exam kit
B.customer: Alex M. (patient, lives at Sunrise Gardens care home) · other patients

services.name: Eye exam at the care home
services.story: The main story: a $179 eye exam at Sunrise Gardens care home. Nothing is taken. The office bills Alex's plan its own way.

services.name: Eye exam at the care home
services.story: The same eye exam, paid privately: nothing is taken, and Rosie texts the $179 bill when Marcus texts DONE.

services.name: Eye check for a sore eye
services.story: A sore, red eye at the care home. Only the $89 eye check is promised. Marcus prices any test or treatment at the visit, with Alex's yes first.

services.name: New glasses, delivered and fitted
services.story: New glasses from the exam's prescription, delivered and fitted at Sunrise Gardens: $150, a $40 deposit when booked, and Rosie texts the bill for the rest.

services_shape: visit types in an exam room, each with a set length; an exam has two parts (the optician's pre-tests, then the eye doctor's exam); glasses and contacts are ordered after the exam and picked up, or delivered, when they're ready; every visit needs a free exam room
questions_before_times: for you, your child, or someone you help (a care home resident)
which visit: an eye exam, a contact lens fitting too, or an eye problem visit (the office's own visit types; never a symptom typed into the AI)
a vision plan or medical insurance (its name only), or paying yourself
safety_stop: sudden vision loss, sudden flashes of light, or a shadow or curtain across the vision
a chemical splash in the eye, or something stuck in it
an eye hit hard or cut, or sudden bad eye pain with a headache or throwing up
first_steps: Health history, consent and the plan's papers
A written price estimate for self-pay patients
The care home's or school's OK
license: always: each optometrist holds their own active license from the state's optometry board
staff_skills: eye doctors: exams, contact lens fittings, dilating drops, eye problem visits and prescriptions; opticians: pre-tests, frames and lenses, glasses fittings and repairs, and teaching contact lens care; only people cleared for visits away go to care homes and schools
messages_never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the plan, the reason, results or a prescription; at the office, not the eye doctor's name either; when the eye doctor or optician comes to a care home, school or home, their name stays, for the door check; a READY text says only that the order is ready to pick up
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
